mentions.name: What Is HackerNews Working On?
mentions.description: A searchable, filterable table of "What Are You Working On?" comments from Hacker News, with tagging that lets users find their own post and discover other comments with the same tags to locate people working on similar projects.
mentions.audience: Hacker News users who posted on "What Are You Working On?" threads and want to discover others doing similar things
